message:
fix(apk, sh-strength r4): B never draws video into the wrong size, redraws a still picture with a new layout, and holds a touch until its layout is shown

Codex codex_sh_strength_r3.md N1 a-c.
a) No fall-through after two cleared swaps: video goes only into an output of the placement's view size. A
   waiting draw is retried every 16 ms; one layout episode is bounded (1 s), then the renderer fails -> the
   policy's direct path. The cleared swap's own result is checked, and it carries the last frame's timestamp
   (or a marker the view's latch ignores) so it is never counted as a new frame.
b) Two waits apart: a new frame not latched yet, and the latched frame's REDRAW with the new layout -- the
   retry redraws it (no updateTexImage, its timestamp kept) with no new decoder frame.
c) Each placement is sent with a generation; the renderer names the layout of its last VIDEO swap
   (swappedPlacementGen), read at the TextureView's latch. While B draws a layout the view has not shown,
   a remote touch starting then is not sent (input_held_layout); the next one, once shown, is. Pan stays local.
   Limit: the read at the latch can credit a swap one buffer early.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
